channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Em resposta a Lula, EUA dizem ter interesse em eleições do Brasil
item.description: The U.S. State Department said it has an interest in Brazil’s democratic process, responding to President Lula’s challenge to Secretary Marco Rubio to form a committee supporting Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential bid. Lula had declared he would defeat all opponents in defense of democracy and invited international observers, including Americans, to monitor the elections. U.S.-Brazil tensions have intensified due to new tariffs, the designation of criminal groups as terrorists, and reciprocal criticisms between Lula and Rubio.

item.title: Ligação de Alexandre Frota ao vivo gera suspeita de contato com Bolsonaro
item.description: A live call made by Alexandre Frota during the TMC podcast sparked suspicions that he had contacted Jair Bolsonaro, who is currently under house arrest with bans on cell phone and social media use. Frota did not disclose who was on the other end, nor did the podcast hosts, but social media users claimed to recognize Bolsonaro's voice. STF-imposed restrictions prohibit Bolsonaro from using any external communication means, directly or through third parties.

item.title: Mendonça trata Flávio com rigor que assombra os bolsonaristas
item.description: André Mendonça, appointed by Jair Bolsonaro to the Supreme Federal Court on the grounds that the tribunal needed a 'terribly evangelical' minister, took a strict stance against Flávio Bolsonaro on Thursday. His decision was seen as a significant setback for the senator and his bolsonarist allies, who viewed Mendonça’s move as a betrayal of expected loyalty. The phrase 'served Flávio Bolsonaro the bread that the Tinhoso kneaded' implies he is now facing the consequences of his own actions — a metaphor for poetic justice.

item.title: Republicanos cobra reciprocidade do PL para fechar aliança com Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The Republicans demand reciprocity from the PL to form a national alliance with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in the 2026 presidential race, claiming the PL did not support Republican gubernatorial candidates in exchange. The party says it has chances to elect governors in six states, including São Paulo and Minas Gerais, and views the alliance as strategic to secure first-round victories in Mato Grosso and Roraima, while boosting PL senators. Without concessions, the Republicans threaten to remain nationally neutral and ruled out supporting Lula.

item.title: EUA anunciam sobretaxa de 12,5% sobre produtos brasileiros
item.description: The United States announced a 12.5% surtax on Brazilian products, which, when added to the previous 25% tariff, results in a total tariff of 37.5% effective July 24, 2026. The measure is based on a Section 301 trade investigation that concluded Brazil failed to ban imports of goods made with forced labor. In addition to Brazil, 59 other countries were targeted, including Argentina, China, Canada, and the European Union.

item.title: Novo lançará Zema à Presidência no Edifício Íon, em Brasília
item.description: The New Party will hold its national convention on Monday, July 27, 2026, at the Íon Building in Brasília to officially nominate Romeu Zema as its presidential candidate. The event will be hybrid, with national president Eduardo Ribeiro attending in person and other leaders joining virtually. The vice-presidential candidate will be announced later, before the August 5 deadline, with Geraldo Rufino (Podemos) and Michelle Bolsonaro (PL) mentioned as possibilities, though she has ruled out joining the ticket.

item.title: Em meio a divergências, PSDB-Cidadania apoiará reeleição de Tarcísio
item.description: The PSDB-Cidadania Federation announced its support for the re-election of São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) in a statement released on Thursday, July 23, a decision to be ratified at the state convention on July 28. The support follows internal party divisions, where a faction had proposed a candidacy with former senator José Aníbal, but it was dismissed as an isolated move. The federation will also launch a major Senate candidacy, with Soninha Francine as one of its pre-candidates, reaffirming its commitment to unity and strengthening a political project for the state.

item.title: Governo Trump reage a fala de Lula e diz se interessar por ‘integridade’ das eleições
item.description: The U.S. government responded to Lula's remarks about Marco Rubio's ties to the Bolsonaro family, avoiding direct polemic but reaffirming its interest in freedom of expression and electoral integrity in Brazil. Lula had challenged Rubio to openly support Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, accusing U.S.-aligned figures of seeking to undermine Brazilian democracy. The remarks come amid Flávio Bolsonaro's repeated, discredited claims about electronic voting machines.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: STF autoriza investigação de repasses ao filme ‘Dark Horse’
item.description: The Supreme Federal Court (STF) has authorized the Federal Police to open an investigation into financial transfers made by businessman Daniel Vorcaro to the production of the film 'Dark Horse', with possible involvement of public funds. The probe focuses on negotiations mediated by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and aims to clarify whether part of the 61 million reais involved had illicit origins or was directed toward political favors. The case raises suspicions of money laundering and improper use of public money in a cinematic project linked to allies of former President Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Michelle vai gravar vídeo para ‘agradecer’ por manifestação de Flávio
item.description: Former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro plans to record a thank-you video for Senator Flávio Bolsonaro after his social media post in which he apologized for past discomforts and invited her to 'walk together' politically. The move suggests a potential reconciliation within the Bolsonaro camp, as Flávio positions himself as a pre-candidate for president in 2026.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro convida Michelle para campanha e pede desculpas
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro publicly apologized to Michelle Bolsonaro and invited her to join his presidential campaign, meeting a condition set by PL president Valdemar Costa Neto for a possible reconciliation. The gesture comes amid internal crises, including unfounded allegations about electronic voting machines and scrutiny over invoices from his law firm. Michelle Bolsonaro liked the Instagram post, indicating openness to the invitation.

item.title: Valdemar diz que insistirá para Michelle voltar ao comando do PL Mulher após pedido de desculpas de Flávio
item.description: PL president Valdemar Costa Neto said he will try to convince Michelle Bolsonaro to return as head of PL Mulher after her son, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, publicly apologized for their rift. He stated she is irreplaceable in leading the party's women's wing and plans to meet her next week. Despite optimism about reconciliation, Valdemar believes Michelle will not attend the PL's national convention this Saturday due to her continued presence alongside jailed former President Jair Bolsonaro under house arrest.

item.title: Valdemar celebra pedido de desculpas de Flávio a Michelle
item.description: PL party president Valdemar Costa Neto praised a video in which Senator Flávio Bolsonaro publicly apologized to former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro and invited her to 'walk together,' stating that their public feud had harmed the campaign. He said there is still time to change things by the 5th and pledged to work toward that goal.

item.title: Dólar sobe e fecha a R$ 5,085 com Brent acima de US$ 100 e tarifaço
item.description: The commercial dollar closed up 0.62% at R$5.0852, while the Ibovespa fell 0.60% to 176,480.20 points. The dollar’s rise was driven by risk-off sentiment amid escalating U.S.-Iran tensions, Brent crude surpassing $100 per barrel, and new U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods, which raised trade uncertainty. The Lula government launched the third phase of the Brasil Soberano program to support sectors affected by the tariffs.

item.title: Flávio não pediu desculpas a Michelle; foi obrigado a pedir
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) issued a public apology to Michelle Bolsonaro and invited her to join him in the 2026 presidential race, but the gesture was interpreted as driven by electoral polls rather than genuine remorse. The analysis suggests the move was a forced political strategy responding to opinion data, not a spontaneous act of reconciliation.

item.title: Eduardo Bolsonaro volta a descredibilizar sistema eleitoral após dado falso de Flávio sobre urnas
item.description: Former federal deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro (PL) revived suspicions about the integrity of Brazil's electoral system on Thursday afternoon (07/23/2026), reiterating criticisms after his brother, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), disseminated false information about electronic voting machines during a meeting with ambassadors in Brasília. Eduardo's remarks come amid growing concerns over electoral misinformation and political polarization in the country.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro faz aceno a evangélicos em vídeo de pré-campanha
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) released a pre-campaign video invoking his father's legacy and directing messages to evangelical voters, emphasizing faith, hope and urgency for change. The senator, also a presidential pre-candidate, faces declining poll numbers with 42% voting intention and 50% rejection according to Real Time Big Data, trailing Lula (45% and 48%).

item.title: A bombeira decisiva na trégua entre Flávio e Michelle Bolsonaro
item.description: A month after Michelle Bolsonaro recorded a video criticizing Flávio Bolsonaro, the senator decided to publicly apologize to the former first lady. The post has already received a like from Michelle, who is expected to respond with another video.

item.title: Análise: pedido de desculpas atrasado de Flávio Bolsonaro a Michelle pode ser visto pelo eleitor como arranjo político
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's delayed apology to Michelle Bolsonaro may be seen by voters as a political arrangement, given it came nearly a month after her public lament and following polling showing the family feud hurt the campaign. The video appears more as an attempt to quell internal PL conflicts over candidate support and funding than a sincere remorse, reinforcing perceptions of post-crisis negotiation.

item.title: Contra o vira-latismo
item.description: President Lula seeks to establish a council to control the exploration of critical minerals, especially rare earths, to strengthen Brazil’s geopolitical position and support national industrialization, inspired by U.S. and Chinese models. The initiative faces resistance from private mining companies, Congress, and even factions within his own government, including Minister Alexandre Silveira of Mines and Energy, who lobbies against the Planalto Palace’s proposals.

item.title: Pré-candidato do Psol evita condenar crimes sexuais atribuídos ao Hamas
item.description: PSOL's pre-candidate for the Chamber of Deputies from Pernambuco, Jones Manoel, avoided specifically condemning the rapes and other sexual violence attributed to Hamas during the October 7, 2023 attacks on Israel. When confronted by Recife city councilor Eduardo Moura (Novo), Manoel reaffirmed his support for 'all forms' of Palestinian resistance without condemning the sexual violence. The stance sparked controversy and was widely reported by conservative media.

item.title: Michelle será convidada para convenção de Flávio e terá proposta para voltar ao PL Mulher
item.description: Former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro (PL) will be invited to the convention that will formalize Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) as the presidential candidate in 2026 and will receive a proposal to resume leadership of PL Women. The event will take place next week and reinforces the family's political articulation within the party.

item.title: Governo Lula avalia que nova tarifa dos EUA por trabalho forçado se somará a sobretaxa de 25%
item.description: The Lula government assesses that the U.S. investigation into forced labor will lead to new tariffs that will add to the existing 25% surcharge, potentially reaching a cumulative rate of 37.5% for certain sectors. The decision is expected to be announced this Thursday (23).

item.title: Flávio pede desculpas a Michelle e diz que “ninguém é perfeito”
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro publicly apologized to former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro in a social media video, two days before the PL convention that will launch him as the party's 2026 presidential candidate. He praised her leadership of PL Mulher, her care for jailed ex-president Jair Bolsonaro, and her advocacy for rare diseases and the deaf community, urging conservative unity to defeat Lula.

item.title: Manual do Eleitor: entenda como vai funcionar a biometria nas Eleições 2026
item.description: Biometric identification will be used in all polling stations during the 2026 elections to enhance voter identification security, as established by TSE Resolution No. 23.759/2026. Voting will not be denied due to biometric recognition failure or lack of biometric registration, ensuring universal access to the vote.

item.title: Haddad usa caos na CPTM para criticar concessões em SP, e Tarcísio silencia
item.description: Fernando Haddad, the main opposition pre-candidate for São Paulo governor, used today’s breakdown of CPTM train lines 11-Coral, 12-Safira, and 13-Jade to criticize public service concessions in the state, stating that if elected, he will review rail concession contracts and the privatization of Sabesp. He blamed the current administration for the chaos and positioned himself as a defender of reversing privatizations. Incumbent Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, an ally of the federal government, has not publicly commented on the incident.

item.title: Ao vivo: PoderDataCast discute tarifaço de Trump e aprovação de Lula
item.description: The PoderDataCast discusses the improvement in President Lula's approval following Trump's tariff hike, with PoderData polling showing a 10-point drop in negative ratings (from 47% to 37%) and a 3-point rise in positive ratings (from 33% to 36%) between July 18–20. The live YouTube episode features former ambassador Rubens Barbosa and analyzes how U.S. tariffs on 3,000 Brazilian products impact the October 2026 elections. The 25% tariff, effective July 22, targets industrial and agricultural goods while exempting crude oil, coffee, and other key exports.

item.title: Adversário de Alcolumbre diz ao TSE ter ficado mais pobre em 2 anos
item.description: Former Macapá mayor Dr. Furlan (PSD) told the TSE his assets decreased by R$ 100,000 between 2024 and 2026, dropping from R$ 1.262 million to R$ 1.168 million. He is currently the frontrunner in Amapá gubernatorial polls with 65.5% voter intent, per Paraná Pesquisas, and is running against incumbent governor Clécio Luís, who is backed by Senate President Davi Alcolumbre.

item.title: Michelle justifica ausência em convenção de Flávio por ter de cuidar de Bolsonaro
item.description: Former first lady Michelle Bolsonaro justified her absence from the PL convention that will officially nominate Flávio Bolsonaro as presidential candidate, stating she needs to care for former president Jair Bolsonaro. She told allies on July 23, 2026, that she will not attend the event scheduled for Saturday, July 25.

item.title: Isolado, Flávio vê aliados adiarem decisão sobre apoio
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) is isolated in his attempt to build a presidential ticket for 2026, arriving at his party's convention without a running mate and seeing potential allies delay their support decisions. With less than two weeks left before the deadline to finalize candidacies, he has failed to assemble the coalition he sought. This reflects broader challenges in uniting the Bolsonarist political base.

item.title: Saiba quais são os 22 setores beneficiados pelo Brasil Soberano 3
item.description: The federal government launched Brazil Sovereign 3, a credit program allocating R$18.5 billion to 22 sectors affected by U.S. tariffs (Sections 232 and 301), including steel, automotive, technology, and Persian Gulf exporters. The initiative aims to protect national competitiveness and consolidate economic sovereignty, with differentiated credit lines by sector group.

item.title: Privatizações viraram passivo eleitoral de Tarcísio de Freitas
item.description: The privatization of public services in São Paulo, particularly the management of Enel in the electricity distribution sector, has become an electoral liability for Governor Tarcísio de Freitas. His response to widespread blackouts — blaming trees instead of the utility company — was widely criticized and damaged his political standing. Privatization has emerged as a persistent attack point from opposition groups and citizens, undermining his image in a state where the quality of essential services is a key electoral concern.

item.title: Fim da escala 6×1? Os pedidos de setor supermercadista em encontro com Zema
item.description: Representatives of the São Paulo Supermarkets Association delivered a document to presidential pre-candidate Romeu Zema with proposals to modernize labor relations, improve consumption metering, and create a National Retail Council, amid discussions on the PEC to end the 6×1 work scale. Zema also commented on electronic voting machines, acknowledging the possibility of minor fraud but asserting it would not affect election outcomes, and advocated for printing votes for audit in 5% of machines.

item.title: Governo Lula diz ver com 'preocupação' anúncio de Ortega e apela a autoridades da Nicarágua que garantam eleições livres
item.description: The Lula government expressed concern over Daniel Ortega's announcement that there will be no elections in Nicaragua, urging Nicaraguan authorities to ensure free, periodic, plural, and transparent elections, in line with Brazil's deep commitment to democracy. The Itamaraty statement emphasized that such elections are a cornerstone of democracy and called on Nicaraguan authorities to guarantee the Nicaraguan people's sovereign right to freely choose their leaders.

item.title: Crusoé: Caiado de IA na convenção do PSD
item.description: The PSD will hold its convention on Sunday, the 26th, in São Paulo, to officially nominate Ronaldo Caiado as its presidential candidate, with Gilberto Kassab as his running mate. The event will feature a strong digital component, including an artificial intelligence version of the former Goiás governor who will interact with the audience.

item.title: O que querem os Bolsonaros?
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro criticizes electronic voting machines, challenging the moderate image he had cultivated. His stance radicalizes the Bolsonaro family's discourse on election integrity, creating internal and external tensions. The move may alienate moderate voters while pleasing the more conservative base.

item.title: “Flávio vai para a eleição sozinho. Ele e Vorcaro”, diz Renan
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate for the Missão party, stated that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) is heading into the election alone, following the withdrawal of strategic support from agribusiness, religious groups, and financial markets. He mocked the loss of backing and referenced reports linking Flávio to former banker Daniel Vorcaro, implying his candidacy is weakened by lack of alliances and controversial associations.

item.title: Mendonça autorizou investigação de Flávio um dia após parecer da PGR
item.description: Justice André Mendonça authorized the opening of an inquiry at the STF to investigate Senator Flávio Bolsonaro over alleged irregularities in funds from Banco Master to the film Dark Horse, one day after the PGR expressed support for the investigation. Flávio Bolsonaro is targeted for negotiating the sponsorship with banker Daniel Vorcaro, and the case involves his privileged forum as a senator.

item.title: Por que PF vai investigar repasses de Vorcaro para filme sobre Jair Bolsonaro feitos a pedido de Flávio
item.description: Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça authorized the Federal Police to open an investigation into financial transfers from Vorcaro company to the film 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro, made at the request of Flávio Bolsonaro. The probe aims to determine whether the funds were used to support the lifestyle of former deputy Eduardo Bolsonaro in the United States. The decision followed a favorable opinion from the Attorney General's Office.

item.title: Ciro agradece aliança com o PL no Ceará: “Exemplo para o Brasil”
item.description: Pre-candidate for Governor of Ceará, Ciro Gomes (PSDB), thanked the PL Ceará for its support during the party convention, calling the alliance an 'example for Brazil' in reducing political radicalization and helping the people overcome challenges. He criticized the state government’s abandonment of its duties and emphasized that the partnership with the PL offers a path of dialogue and concrete solutions for Ceará’s problems.

item.title: CPTM deve retomar a operação de trens após falhas e incêndio em São Paulo
item.description: Artesp ordered the resumption of train operations on lines 11-Coral, 12-Safira, and 13-Jade by CPTM following failures and a fire on line 12-Safira caused by an explosion that completely carbonized a train. The decision comes two days after the lines were concessioned to private operator Trivia Trens, part of Governor Tarcísio de Freitas’ privatization plan. Operations will resume for 90 days to ensure service quality and prevent further incidents.

item.title: Fala de Flávio sobre urnas impulsiona postagens de esquerda nas redes sociais
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) made false claims about electronic voting machines during a meeting with ambassadors on Tuesday (21), which sparked widespread sharing of left-wing narratives on social media. The statement, deemed misinformation, was widely circulated and criticized by progressive content creators who used it to highlight attacks on electoral integrity. The incident occurred amid rising pre-election tensions in 2026, with Bolsonaro positioning himself as a presidential pre-candidate.

item.title: Caiado critica Lula após dados sobre roubo de celulares no Brasil
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) criticized President Lula (PT) after citing data from the 2025 Brazilian Public Security Yearbook showing rising cellphone theft and robbery rates in Brazil. In a post on X, Caiado accused Lula of 'pretending to be the father of the poor' while crime increases, using the statistics to challenge the effectiveness of federal security policies.

item.title: Renan diz que Flávio está isolado: "Irá ele e Vorcaro para eleição"
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate from the Missão party, stated that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) is becoming politically isolated, losing support from agribusiness, religious sectors, financial markets, and the Centrão. He accused Flávio of running a 'fear campaign' focused on attacking Lula, attracting only elderly voters and workers fearful of the PT, without presenting concrete proposals. Renan said Flávio and Daniel Vorcaro will be the only ones running in the election under these conditions.

item.title: A ofensiva de Renan Santos sobre segmento que Flávio e Caiado nadam de braçada
item.description: Renan Santos, the Missão party's presidential candidate, intensified his campaign in the Central-West region, meeting with agribusiness leaders, including former minister Blairo Maggi, to gain ground in a sector dominated by Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Ronaldo Caiado (PSD). His offensive comes as Flávio's pre-candidacy weakens amid campaign crises, and aims to prevent Caiado from aligning too closely with the second tier of presidential contenders, which also includes Romeu Zema (Novo).

item.title: Após embate entre Michelle e Flávio, PL oficializa apoio a Ciro Gomes
item.description: The Liberal Party (PL) officially endorsed Ciro Gomes' gubernatorial bid in Ceará following a state convention, ending weeks of internal conflict between Michelle Bolsonaro, who backed an alternative faction, and Flávio Bolsonaro, who supported the decision. The convention also nominated Alcides Fernandes for Senate, sidelining Priscila Costa, while Ciro Gomes welcomed the alliance, stressing the need to overcome partisan divides amid rising violence and corruption in the state.

item.title: Lula irá à convenção que oficializará Alckmin como vice
item.description: Lula will attend the PSB national convention on July 29, 2026, to formalize Geraldo Alckmin as his running mate for re-election. The event underscores the PT-PSB alliance, while João Campos, PSB president and gubernatorial candidate in Pernambuco with PT support, will also attend the PT convention on August 2. The first round of the 2026 election is set for October 4, with Lula seeking a historic fourth term.

item.title: O que Flávio Bolsonaro não explicou sobre os R$ 500 mil que recebeu de empresa ligada ao caso Master
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) released a video to explain his ties to companies linked to the Banco Master conglomerate, but failed to clarify key details regarding the R$ 500,000 he received from Contábil Correa, including the nature of the legal service provided, who introduced him to Rogério Lourenço Novo, and why he issued and later canceled two invoices of the same amount to Copenhagen, a firm within the same group. These omissions raise concerns about the legitimacy and transparency of the transactions.

item.title: Até quando Flávio Bolsonaro terá que explicar eventuais ligações com Vorcaro?
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, a pre-candidate for president in 2026, has repeatedly been pressured to clarify alleged ties with businessman Vorcaro, following multiple public demands for explanations. The persistence of the scandal — rather than the allegations themselves — threatens his campaign, as his inability to close the issue leaves him politically vulnerable. The situation highlights the risk of unresolved scandals in contemporary Brazilian politics.

item.title: Lindbergh aciona PF e pede investigação sobre notas fiscais emitidas por escritório de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Federal Deputy Lindbergh Farias (PT-RJ) filed a formal complaint with the Federal Police requesting an investigation into invoices issued by Senator Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL-RJ) law firm totaling R$1.5 million to companies linked to Daniel Vorcaro, controller of Banco Master. The request seeks to consolidate the case with ongoing investigations into Banco Master, Vorcaro, and Trustee DTVM, citing suspicions of money laundering, ideological fraud, and tax crimes. Lindbergh also asks the PF to verify whether services were actually rendered and if the issuance/cancellation of invoices aimed to create a false appearance of legitimacy for fund transfers.
